_comment: Octail's own egg (LinuxGSM's ohdserver settings and its Game.ini were read as a reference only). App 950900 (Operation: Harsh Doorstop Dedicated Server) from anonymous SteamCMD, the Linux build HarshDoorstop/Binaries/Linux/HarshDoorstopServer-Linux-Shipping started with the map and slots as URL options and -Port, -QueryPort, -RconPort and -SteamServerName. Game.ini (HarshDoorstop/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/) is edited with the ini parser before every start: the name, the join password and the RCON switch and password ([/Script/RCON.RCONServerSystem], off until the owner turns it on). Query (+1, A2S: player count and the Players tab list) and RCON (+2, TCP) are automatic port variables; RCON isn't wired to Octail's console. The server reads no console input; start detected by the game port (UDP) from 30 s on; stop with Ctrl+C. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times (its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration"), the steamcmd download times out and retries, and the install fails when the server binary is missing.
name: Operation: Harsh Doorstop
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Operation: Harsh Doorstop is a free, open-ended military sandbox shooter on Unreal Engine 4: large combined-arms battles across modern and historical eras, with deep mod support.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Operation: Harsh Doorstop dedicated server (Octail's own install script; LinuxGSM's ohdserver settings were read as a
# reference only). App 950900, the Linux build, anonymous SteamCMD. Failures exit non-zero.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -uo pipefail

## anonymous login: the Operation: Harsh Doorstop server needs no Steam account
STEAM_USER=anonymous

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps # steamapps: SteamCMD's disk write error when it is missing
if ! curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -o steamcmd.tar.gz \
    https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz; then
    echo "Installation failed: SteamCMD couldn't be downloaded."
    exit 1
fi
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1

# SteamCMD fails otherwise, even running as root; the files are given to the server's user after the install.
chown -R root:root /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install the server with steamcmd (the Linux depot)
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
BETA=()
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || BETA=(-beta "${SRCDS_BETAID}")
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} +app_update "${SRCDS_APPID}" "${BETA[@]}" validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 and 64 bit Steam client libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
BIN=/mnt/server/HarshDoorstop/Binaries/Linux/HarshDoorstopServer-Linux-Shipping
if [[ ! -f "$BIN" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Operation: Harsh Doorstop dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi
chmod +x "$BIN"

## Octail: the server's settings live in HarshDoorstop/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/; Octail sets the name, join password
## and RCON password in Game.ini before every start (the file is made then when it isn't there yet)
mkdir -p /mnt/server/HarshDoorstop/Saved/Config/LinuxServer

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server browser (up to 64 characters, no " or \).

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map the server starts on (LinuxGSM's default AAS-TestMap). The rotation after it is in HarshDoorstop/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/MapCycle.cfg (Argonne, Montecassino, LamDong, Khafji_P, Risala, ...).

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join. Empty = anyone can join.

variables.name: RCON
variables.description: True turns on the server's remote console on the RCON port (for admin tools; set an RCON Password first).

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: The remote console password (8-64 letters, digits, - and _). Hidden once saved.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Steam query port (UDP), passed as -QueryPort. Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: Remote console port (TCP), passed as -RconPort. Set by Octail when the server is created (two after the game port).

variables.name: App ID
variables.description: The Steam app id of the Operation: Harsh Doorstop dedicated server.

variables.name: Beta Branch
variables.description: Optional: a Steam beta branch of the server; empty for the public build. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD before every start (1), or start the installed files (0). Players can only join a server of their own game version.
